''See also: [[sword aura Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sword [[aura]] is a specialized form of energy that accumulates around objects with sharp edges, most notably swords. It can be generated by channeling [[madra]] into a weapon or through specific techniques like the [[Flowing Sword]], which allows the [[aura]] to grow in strength and density with every movement. Visually, it often manifests as a silver glow or halo around a blade, though its appearance can vary based on the source of power. In high concentrations, it can appear as a silver storm or a radiant dome that acts like a thicket of blades. Functionally, [[sword]] [[aura]] is primarily offensive and lacks defensive capabilities; it is designed to cut rather than shield. It can be used to create razor-sharp waves of energy, explosive detonations within a target, or even massive storms of invisible blades. When manipulated through advanced techniques like the [[Endless Sword]], it can resonate with other weapons or transform surrounding [[vital aura]] into more [[sword]] [[aura]]. While it is often tied to physical blades, the energy itself can be used to forge weapons or manifest as extensions of a user's reach, capable of slicing through objects from a distance.}}
